title: Nominee Director Crisis Indian Law Refuses To Confront
description: It is July 2026, two months after the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (Amendment) Act, 2026 came into force. In Mumbai, in a boardroom, a director appointed by an institutional lender is looking at the agenda item that will shape a company for the next eighteen months. The emergency interim financing super-priority debt proposed in the resolution may keep the company alive.
